# Search Command Tests — FTS5 search with BM25 ranking

# --- Setup: initialize KB and write pages ---

exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write search-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/search-note.md'

stdin ../note2-input.md
exec akb write another-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/another-note.md'

stdin ../adr-input.md
exec akb write search-decision.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/search-decision.md'

# --- Search finds page by content ---

exec akb search "distributed"
stdout 'notes/search-note.md'

# --- Search finds page by title ---

exec akb search 'Search Test Note'
stdout 'notes/search-note.md'

# --- Search finds page by tags ---

exec akb search "searchtest"
stdout 'notes/search-note.md'
stdout 'notes/another-note.md'

# --- Search with multi-word query ---

exec akb search 'distributed systems'
stdout 'notes/search-note.md'

# --- Search returns results in BM25 rank order ---

exec akb search "distributed"
stdout 'Search Test Note'

# --- Search with no matches produces no output ---

exec akb search "xyznonexistent"
! stdout .

# --- Search with --json flag produces JSON output ---

exec akb search --json "distributed"
stdout '"path"'
stdout '"title"'
stdout '"rank"'

# --- Search with empty query returns error ---

! exec akb search ""
stderr 'search query must not be empty'

# --- Search with special characters (stripped by FTS5 escaping) ---

exec akb search "distributed*"
stdout 'notes/search-note.md'

# --- Search with FTS5 operators (OR, AND, NOT stripped) ---

exec akb search 'distributed OR systems'
stdout 'notes/search-note.md'

# --- Search finds ADR content ---

exec akb search "architecture"
stdout 'decisions/search-decision.md'

# --- Search snippet contains match context ---

exec akb search 'Search Test Note'
stdout '→Search←'

# --- Missing search.db produces rebuild hint ---

# Remove search.db to simulate missing database
exec rm .akb/search.db

! exec akb search "distributed"
stderr 'akb index rebuild'

# --- Rebuild restores search functionality ---

exec akb index rebuild
stdout 'Index rebuilt'

exec akb search "distributed"
stdout 'notes/search-note.md'

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Search Test Note
summary: A note for search testing
tags: searchtest
---
This note is about distributed systems and consensus algorithms.

-- note2-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Another Search Note
summary: Second note for search
tags: searchtest
---
Content about machine learning and neural networks.

-- adr-input.md --
---
type: adr
title: Search Decision
status: proposed
deciders: team
summary: Decision for search testing
tags: searchtest
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-01-01'
---
## Context

The architecture needs a searchable decision record.

## Decision

We decided to use distributed systems for our architecture.

## Consequences

The decision is indexed alongside notes.
